protocol.name: prospective_regularized_recovery_under_review_label_noise
protocol.review_usage: adaptation only; balanced nested labeled budgets
protocol.validation_usage: resumption gate and action selection only
protocol.shadow_validation_usage: independent second resumption gate only; final audit excluded
protocol.final_audit_usage: reporting only; excluded from action and budget selection
protocol.review_label_noise_usage: training review labels only; validation, shadow, and audit labels remain clean

selected_policy.selection_basis: minimum label budget, then serialized size, then validation macro-F1; all configured validation gates required; final audit excluded

diagnosis.method: mean per-feature JSD on label-blind final-audit windows

notes: Target labels are used only after shift detection and within explicit recovery roles.
Review, resumption-validation, and final-audit rows are disjoint.
The selected action and label budget use validation and resource measurements only; final-audit metrics are reporting-only.
SAFE_TO_RESUME is a protocol decision under frozen criteria, not a guarantee of production safety.
Feature-level JSD is descriptive shift attribution, not causal attack explanation.
